events.title: Steam Next Fest, Here We Come!
events.summary: Yes, we're participating in October's Steam Next Fest! We've also updated our demo for the occasion. events.title: Woohoo, it's the Deckbuilders Fest 2026!
events.summary: Hey everyone! Happy to share that we're part of this year's Deckbuilders Fest!Sure, our game might not look like a typical card game, but it still brings that deckbuilding-style fun in its own way: by adding or selling bricks in your backpack, you get to change the types and ratios of bricks that show up in play, which directly shapes your strategy and approach to the game.That said, there's still not a ton of content at this stage, so the experience might feel a bit simple for now.
